programs.title: Willie Nelson: The Outlaw Country King
programs.desc: Fuse delivers music-centric lifestyle programming, multicultural reality series, and docuseries showcasing diverse artists and creators.

programs.title: Elvis Presley: Shook Up
programs.desc: Behind the glitz and glamour of rock 'n' roll royalty is the haunting tale of Elvis Presley; many question his moral fiber and notorious violent temper; devilish charm dressed in angelic white had friends and fans fooled for too long.

programs.title: Bruce Springsteen: Born to Rock
programs.desc: Following electrifying rock star Bruce Springsteen's career from the Jersey Shore to sold-out live performances in stadiums around the globe.

programs.title: David Bowie: Out of This World
programs.desc: Few artists marked the 20th century like David Bowie marked it. He was an astonishing and eclectic performer whose work brought a new dimension to the music scene and queer culture. Driven, fierce and always wanting to escape conformity, he was an outsider and was considered as a man from another planet.

programs.title: Reggie Yates' Extreme Russia
programs.desc: In Russia, Reggie Yates finds out what life is like for young gay people; in the U.K., Reggie discovers that, for young Black and Muslim LGBTQ+ folk, their harshest critics and persecutors come from their own communities, or even their own families.

programs.title: Reggie Yates' Extreme Russia
programs.sub_title: Teen Model Factory and Six Packs
programs.desc: Reggie Yates visits Siberia to meet the young girls who are going to extreme lengths to attract the international scouts and make it as fashion models in the West; Reggie investigates the ways in which male body culture is impacting young men.
